name: List All Properties
description: Returns all properties that meet the filter criteria

queryFilters.name: filters[Id]
queryFilters.description: Filter by the unique identifier of the property. All GET requests must include a filter for [Id] (if available) or [LastUpdatedAtFrom].

queryFilters.name: filters[LastUpdatedAtFrom]
queryFilters.description: Filter properties updated at or after this date-time. All GET requests must include a filter for [Id] (if available) or [LastUpdatedAtFrom].

queryFilters.name: filters[PropertyType]
queryFilters.description: Filter by property type. Accepts comma-separated values such as Single-Family, Multi-Family, Commercial.

responseFields.name: data
responseFields.description: Array of property objects

responseFields.name: data[].Id
responseFields.description: Unique identifier of the property retrieved

responseFields.name: data[].CustomFields
responseFields.description: The custom fields for the associated entity

responseFields.name: data[].HasHomeWarrantyCoverage
responseFields.description: Indicates whether or not the property has home warranty coverage

responseFields.name: data[].HomeWarrantyInfo
responseFields.description: Contains information about the property's home warranty coverage

responseFields.name: data[].HiddenAt
responseFields.description: When the property was placed into an inactive state by an AppFolio Property Manager user

responseFields.name: data[].LastUpdatedAt
responseFields.description: The date the property group's details were last updated

responseFields.name: data[].LeaseFeePolicy
responseFields.description: Contains details about the property's lease fee policy

responseFields.name: data[].Link
responseFields.description: A link to the property page in the AppFolio Property Manager

responseFields.name: data[].PortfolioId
responseFields.description: Unique identifier of the portfolio associated with the property

responseFields.name: data[].PropertyGroupIds
responseFields.description: Unique identifier(s) of the property group(s) associated with the property

responseFields.name: data[].PropertyType
responseFields.description: The type of property

responseFields.name: data[].PostedToInternet
responseFields.description: Indicates whether the Single-Family (SFR) property has been posted to a third-party listings page. Returns null if property type is not SFR.

responseFields.name: data[].PostedToWebsite
responseFields.description: Indicates whether a vacant Single-Family (SFR) property was posted to the AppFolio listings page. Returns null if property type is not SFR.

responseFields.name: data[].TenantPortalLink
responseFields.description: Link that can be used to direct a resident to their tenant portal

responseFields.name: data[].AdminFee
responseFields.description: The admin fee associated with the property

responseFields.name: data[].Amenities
responseFields.description: The amenities associated with the property

responseFields.name: data[].CatsAllowed
responseFields.description: The property's cat policy. Valid values include "Yes", "No" or null.

responseFields.name: data[].Class
responseFields.description: Indicates the type and quality of the property based on factors such as age, location, amenities, and overall condition.

responseFields.name: data[].CurrentManagementFeePolicy
responseFields.description: Contains details about the property's current management fee policy

responseFields.name: data[].DogsAllowed
responseFields.description: The property's dog policy.

responseFields.name: data[].InsuranceExpiration
responseFields.description: The date the property's insurance expires

responseFields.name: data[].MaintenanceLimit
responseFields.description: The dollar amount limit to not exceed for maintenance

responseFields.name: data[].MaintenanceNotes
responseFields.description: A brief informative message about the property's maintenance

responseFields.name: data[].ManagementEndDate
responseFields.description: The date when the current management of the property ended

responseFields.name: data[].ManagementEndReason
responseFields.description: The reason for the end of the current management of the property

responseFields.name: data[].ManagementStartDate
responseFields.description: The date when the current management of the property began

responseFields.name: data[].Name
responseFields.description: The name of the property

responseFields.name: data[].NsfFee
responseFields.description: The non-sufficient funds (NSF) fee associated with the property

responseFields.name: data[].SiteManager
responseFields.description: Contains the property site manager's contact information and details

responseFields.name: data[].UnitEntryPreAuthorized
responseFields.description: Indicates whether or not entry to the unit was pre-authorized

responseFields.name: data[].YearBuilt
responseFields.description: The year in which the property was constructed

responseFields.name: data[].Address1
responseFields.description: The primary street address of the property

responseFields.name: data[].Address2
responseFields.description: Additional street address information pertaining to the property

responseFields.name: data[].City
responseFields.description: The city where the property is located

responseFields.name: data[].State
responseFields.description: The state where the property is located

responseFields.name: data[].Zip
responseFields.description: The zip code where the property is located

responseFields.name: next_page_path
responseFields.description: The URL path to the next page of responses
